changelog: 🖼️ VIDEO FIT controls: Fit / Zoom to Fill / Stretch buttons in Stream Settings (+ pinch zoom & double-tap, now discoverable)
🧊 Frame-truth watchdog: a stream that shows video for 6s+ with zero rendered frames auto-switches mirrors instead of sticking on Connecting — fixes stuck recovery modal
🔑 Permanent release signing key: first update after this is a guided one-time reinstall

🧊 FREEZE FIX (the real one): player now watches actual rendered-video-frame counts — frozen picture with live audio is detected in ~5s and auto-recovers (previous detector watched the audio clock and never fired)
⏱️ Bounded stream retries: dead CDNs now fail over to the next mirror instead of hanging on Connecting for minutes
🔑 Switched to the permanent release signing key — first update after this needs a one-time reinstall, then all future updates are one-tap again
